moduleTitle: The environment and where people live

questions.examTip: Structure your description in three parts: what you see, an opinion, and a personal link — this shows range beyond simple description.
questions.modelAnswer:
Sur la photo, je vois trois poubelles de couleurs différentes pour le verre, le papier et le plastique, devant un immeuble. Je pense que les habitants utilisent ce système pour trier leurs déchets. À mon avis, le recyclage est essentiel parce qu'il permet de réduire la pollution et de protéger les ressources naturelles.

(English translation: In the photo, I can see three different coloured bins for glass, paper and plastic, outside a block of flats. I think residents use this system to sort their waste. In my opinion, recycling is essential because it helps reduce pollution and protect natural resources.)

Useful phrases: trier les déchets; il permet de + infinitive; protéger les ressources naturelles
questions.question: Describe this photo of three coloured recycling bins (glass, paper, plastic) outside a block of flats. Say what the photo shows, what people are doing (or should do), and give your opinion on recycling.

evidence: il y a trop de pollution
je vais à l'école à vélo
questions.examTip: Prepare flexible phrases for the unexpected question in advance; you cannot predict it exactly, but a stock structure (opinion + reason + example) will fit almost any topic.
questions.modelAnswer:
— Il y a trop de pollution causée par les voitures dans ma ville.
— Il faudrait développer plus de pistes cyclables et de transports en commun.
— (Question imprévue) Personnellement, je recycle à la maison et je vais à l'école à vélo.

(English translation: — There is too much pollution caused by cars in my town.
— More cycle paths and public transport should be developed.
— (Unexpected question) Personally, I recycle at home and I cycle to school.)

Useful phrases: il y a trop de pollution; il faudrait + infinitive; je vais à l'école à vélo
questions.question: Role-play: your teacher plays a French local councillor discussing environmental problems. You must (1) mention an environmental problem in your area, (2) suggest a solution, and (3) answer an unexpected question about what you personally do to help the environment.
Describe an imagined photograph showing the environment and where people live. Include a person, an action, a place, an opinion with a reason and one past or future detail.

questions.question:
Read aloud, then discuss: « Ma ville est agréable mais il y a trop de circulation. Ma famille recycle les bouteilles et nous utilisons les transports en commun. À l'avenir, il faudra consommer moins de plastique. »
Give the main message, one agreement, one disagreement and a personal extension.
questions.modelAnswer: The main message is: My town is pleasant but there is too much traffic. My family recycles bottles and we use public transport. In the future, we will have to consume less plastic.. Je suis d'accord avec... mais je pense aussi que... Pour ma part...

note.summary:
The environment and where people live
Key vocabulary
- le recyclage
- une énergie renouvelable
- pollué
- réduire
- le réchauffement climatique

Revision focus
Practise present, past and future forms while discussing the environment and where people live. Build answers with justified opinions and precise examples.

Exam technique
- Spot time markers and negatives before answering.
- Use parce que/car to justify an opinion.
- Check adjective agreement, verb endings and whether the task asks for French or English.
